news_items.headline: Nvidia and Corning announce U.S. co-packaged optics manufacturing partnership; Nvidia invests up to $2.7B
news_items.summary: Nvidia partnered with Corning to build three dedicated U.S. manufacturing plants for co-packaged optics, investing up to $2.7B including warrants for 15M shares. Tech aims to boost data speeds while cutting power consumption up to 20x.

news_items.headline: Nvidia and IREN announce strategic partnership for up to 5 GW of AI infrastructure; Nvidia to invest up to $2.1B
news_items.summary: Nvidia struck a strategic agreement with IREN Limited to accelerate next-generation AI data center deployment, with reports indicating Nvidia investing up to $2.1 billion. IREN stock surged 8% premarket on the news.

news_items.headline: Nvidia falling behind as semiconductors surge — NVDA -4.3% on the week vs AMD +3%, MU +7.3%
news_items.summary: Despite a chip-sector rally that pushed Nasdaq to all-time highs, NVDA fell 4.3% on the week while peers AMD and Micron rallied. Analysts cited rotation concerns and elevated expectations heading into earnings.

news_items.headline: Nvidia stock gains in pre-market on AI-chip demand optimism
news_items.summary: NVDA shares climbed in Wednesday pre-market trading on positive AI/semi industry developments, reflecting growing optimism that AI-chip demand remains strong.

news_items.headline: Goldman Sachs raises NVDA forecasts 12% ahead of May 20 earnings; flags 'major re-rating' possible
news_items.summary: Goldman Sachs upped NVDA forecasts by 12% ahead of the May 20 earnings report and called the stock meaningfully undervalued, citing continued estimate upgrades and valuation multiple expansion as catalysts.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Goldman Sachs raised forecasts ~12% on 2026-05-07 ahead of May 20 earnings, calling NVDA meaningfully undervalued. 37-analyst consensus: 57% Strong Buy, 41% Buy, 3% Hold, 0% Sell.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 FY27 report on May 20 (5 p.m. ET conference call). Street expects EPS $1.74 (+115% YoY) and revenue +78.7% YoY. Bar is high — Goldman says strong execution may already be priced in but flags possible major re-rating.
